name: resend
description: Send transactional emails through the Resend remote MCP server from Codex. Sending, scheduling, audiences, and broadcasts over OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Use Resend from Codex to send transactional emails, schedule deliveries, manage audiences, and send broadcasts. Connects over MCP with OAuth, so no API key handling in the agent.
defaultPrompt: Send a welcome email via Resend to a new user.
